passages.title: Reading the Trail Blazes
sentences: On the Lantern Peaks trails, painted marks on trees and rocks show hikers the way.

Blazes also give directions.
A single blaze means the trail goes straight ahead.
Two blazes stacked one above the other warn that the trail is about to change direction or join another trail at a junction.
If the top blaze is shifted to the right, the turn is to the right, and if it is shifted to the left, the turn is to the left.
At each fork, a wooden signpost adds arrows, trail names and distances.

passages.title: Real or Copy? Dinosaur Hall Labels
sentences: In the Dinosaur Hall at the Harbor Town Fossil Museum, every display has a colored label.
The color tells visitors what kind of object they are looking at.
This matters because many skeletons in museums are not made of real bone.
Real fossils are heavy and can crack, so museums often show casts, which are exact copies made from strong, light materials.
Scientists can then keep the real fossils safe in a lab, where they can study them.
A blue label means the object is a real fossil, and visitors must not touch it.
A white label means the object is a cast, but it is part of a display, so it stays behind the rope.
A green label means the object is a cast made for handling, and visitors are welcome to touch it.
A small star on any label means the real fossil is kept upstairs in the museum's Fossil Lab.
Leo and Ben are visiting the hall with their class.
Leo wants to hold a T. rex tooth, and Ben wants to see a real skull up close.
Before they start, they read the five labels in the first room.

sign.text: ELEVATOR: IN A FIRE ALARM, USE THE STAIRS

items.hint: Read the sign by the elevator first. Then find the door that matches what it says.
items.explain: The class goes out the stairs door. Its sign says EXIT TO STAIRS, and the elevator sign says to use the stairs in a fire alarm.

items.prompt: Priya is standing next to the elevator when the alarm rings. What should she do?
options: Press the elevator button
Wait inside the office
Open the red box on the wall
Walk to the stairs with her class
items.hint: Read the sign next to the elevator. It tells you what to do when the alarm rings.
items.explain: Priya walks to the stairs with her class. The sign by the elevator says IN A FIRE ALARM, USE THE STAIRS.

items.prompt: Maya's water bottle is empty. Which symbol should she look for on the map?
options: Campsite
Campfire ring
Drinking water
Restrooms
items.hint: Think about what Maya needs. Then find the row in the key that gives it.
items.explain: She looks for the 🚰 symbol. The map key says it means drinking water.

items.prompt: Sam brings Pixel on the trail. Tap the row that tells Sam what to do with Pixel.
items.hint: Pixel is a dog. Find the dog symbol, then read across.
items.explain: The last row has the dog symbol 🐕. It says dogs must stay on a leash, so Sam keeps Pixel on his leash.

items.prompt: What should Leo do with his bike before he skates?
options: Ride it around the bowl
Lock it at the bike rack
Leave it by the big ramp
Ride it on the small ramp
items.hint: Find the sign about bikes in the park. Then find the sign that shows where bikes go.
items.explain: Leo locks his bike at the bike rack. One sign says NO BIKES IN THE PARK, and another sign shows the BIKE RACK.

items.prompt: Leo has his helmet on. Tap the place where he can skate today.
items.hint: Read the sign at each place. Check which place is closed today and which place is for bikes.
items.explain: Leo can skate in the bowl. The big ramp sign says CLOSED TODAY. The bowl sign says ONE WAY, which only tells him which way to skate.

items.prompt: Maya wants to take a photo of the big telescope. What should she do?
options: Take the photo with the flash turned on
Take the photo with the flash turned off
Not take any photos at all
Shine a white flashlight on the telescope first
items.hint: Find the sign about photos. Read every word on it, not just the first word.
items.explain: Maya takes the photo with the flash turned off. The red round sign says NO FLASH PHOTOS, so photos are OK without a flash.

items.prompt: It is dark outside, and Sam brought a white flashlight. Tap the sign that tells him this is the wrong kind of light.
items.hint: Look for a sign about lights. Check what time of day it talks about.
items.explain: The sign that says AFTER DARK: RED LIGHTS ONLY tells Sam a white flashlight is the wrong kind. It is the fourth sign.

items.prompt: Sam wants an easy walk with Pixel today. Which trail should they take?
options: Old Mill Path
Fern Hollow
Creek Loop
Big Rock Climb
items.hint: First cross out any trail that is closed today. Then use the key to check the level and the dog symbol.
items.explain: They take Creek Loop. Its row shows 🟢 for easy, 🐕 for dogs, and Open. Old Mill Path is closed today, and Fern Hollow is 🔵 medium.

items.prompt: Leo wants to ride his bike on the longest trail that bikes may use today. Which trail should he pick?
options: Big Rock Climb
Old Mill Path
Fern Hollow
Pine Ridge
items.hint: Find every row with the bike symbol. Cross out the closed one. Then compare the lengths that are left.
items.explain: Leo picks Pine Ridge. Only Pine Ridge and Old Mill Path show 🚲, and Old Mill Path is closed today. Big Rock Climb is longer, but it has no bike symbol.

items.prompt: Mr. Okafor has his bike and a ticket for the ferry to Lantern Peaks pier. Tap the way he should go to board.

sign.text: GATE B STAIRS CLOSED FOR REPAIR

items.hint: First find which gate his ferry leaves from. Then check each way to that gate and whether it is open.
items.explain: He takes the ramp. His ferry leaves from Gate B, the Gate B stairs are closed for repair, and the green sign says BIKE RAMP TO GATE B.

items.prompt: Sam planned to take Pixel on the ferry to Lantern Peaks pier. What do the signs tell him to do?
options: Take Pixel up the bike ramp to Gate B
Take Pixel to Gate B, as long as Pixel stays on his leash
Take Pixel on the ferry to Story Woods dock instead, from Gate A
Take Pixel in the elevator, then walk over to Gate B
items.hint: Find the sign about pets. Then check which gate each ferry leaves from.
items.explain: He takes Pixel on the Story Woods ferry instead. The yellow sign says PETS: GATE A ONLY. The Lantern Peaks ferry leaves from Gate B, and the Gate A ferry goes to Story Woods dock.

items.prompt: Priya's garage is 45°F today, and her kitchen is 70°F. She wants to charge the pack and then race her rover on the dry driveway. What is the best plan?
options: Charge it in the garage, because 45°F is above 32°F
Skip the race, because 45°F is too cold to use the pack
Charge it in the kitchen, then race on the driveway
Charge it in the garage with her tablet charger
items.hint: The temperature row has two rules. Find the rule for using the pack and the rule for charging it, and check each one.
items.explain: She charges it in the kitchen, then races. The Temperature row says to charge only between 50°F and 85°F, but the pack can be used from 32°F, so 45°F is fine for racing.

items.prompt: Priya's battery is full when her rover race starts at 2:00 PM. If she drives the whole time, about when will the battery run out?
options: About 4:00 PM
About 2:20 PM
About 3:45 PM
About 2:45 PM
items.hint: Two rows give amounts of time. Pick the one about driving, not charging. Then add it to 2:00 PM.
items.explain: It will run out at about 2:45 PM. The Run time row says about 45 minutes of driving on a full charge. The 2 hours is the charging time.

items.prompt: It is 3:00 PM on July 10. The yellow flag and the purple flag are both flying. What must Ana do if she wants to swim?
options: Swim anywhere in the swim zone, because yellow is not red
Stay out of the water, because two flags are flying
Wear water shoes and swim past the red-and-yellow flags, away from the jellyfish
Wear water shoes and swim where she can stand, close to the lifeguard tower
items.hint: Find the row that tells you what to do when two flags fly. Then read the rule for each flag and put them together.
items.explain: Ana wears water shoes and swims where she can stand, close to the tower. The Two flags row says to follow every flag, so she follows the Yellow row and the Purple row together.

items.prompt: It is 6:30 PM on August 2, and only the green flag is flying. Ben wants to go for a swim. What is the best decision?
options: Stay out of the water, because the lifeguards went off duty at 6:00 PM
Swim between the red-and-yellow flags, because green means calm water
Swim, because lifeguards are on duty until September 15
Swim only where he can stand, because it is late in the day
items.hint: Check the flag, but also check the clock. Find the row that says when swimming is allowed at all.
items.explain: Ben stays out of the water. The Lifeguards row says they are on duty only until 6:00 PM, and you may swim only when a lifeguard is on duty. September 15 is the last day of the season, not a time of day.

items.prompt: Maya switches off her hot plate at 10:05 AM. At 10:15 AM, she needs to move the beaker that was sitting on it. What should she do?
options: Lift it with her hands, because the hot plate is switched off
Move it with tongs, because the plate stays hot until about 10:25 AM
Lift it with her gloves on, because gloves protect her hands
Wait until 10:20 AM, then lift it with her hands
items.hint: Find the Heat row and add its number of minutes to 10:05 AM. Then check what the Chemicals row says about gloves.
items.explain: She moves it with tongs. The Heat row says hot plates stay hot for 20 minutes, so it is hot until about 10:25 AM. The Chemicals row says gloves do not protect your hands from heat.

items.prompt: Cleanup has started. Priya takes off her goggles to wipe her table. Tap the row that shows she took them off too early.
items.hint: Find the symbol for goggles. Read the whole rule and look for the word that tells you when you may stop.
items.explain: The Eye protection row 🥽 says to wear goggles until all cleanup is finished. Priya is still cleaning up, so it is too early.

items.prompt: Maya has crackers in her pocket. A goat comes to the fence. What should she do with the crackers?
options: Give the goat one cracker
Keep them in her pocket
Drop them over the fence
items.hint: Find the red sign. Read what it says about animals and food.
items.explain: Maya keeps the crackers in her pocket. The red sign says DO NOT FEED THE ANIMALS.

items.prompt: Sam is done petting the goats. Now he wants a pretzel. Tap where he should go first.

sign.text: WASH YOUR HANDS WHEN YOU LEAVE

items.hint: Sam is leaving the barn. Find the sign that tells him what to do when he leaves.
items.explain: Sam goes to the sink first. The blue sign says WASH YOUR HANDS WHEN YOU LEAVE. Then he can get his pretzel at the snack stand.

items.prompt: It is 7:10 PM, and the piano is playing. What should Ana and Ben do?
options: Go in the right door and find their seats
Wait by the doors until the music stops
Go in the left door, because it is closer
Go home, because they missed the start
items.hint: Compare the time they arrived with the start time. Then find the sign for people who arrive after the start.
items.explain: They wait until the music stops. The concert started at 7:00 PM, so they are late, and the red sign says LATE? WAIT HERE UNTIL THE MUSIC STOPS.

items.prompt: The music has stopped. Tap the door Ana and Ben should use.

sign.text: ROWS A TO M: LEFT DOOR
ROWS N TO Z: RIGHT DOOR

items.hint: Find their row letter in the story. Then find the sign whose letters include it.
items.explain: They use the right door. Their row is P, and P comes between N and Z, so the sign says ROWS N TO Z: RIGHT DOOR.

items.prompt: Put Ana and Ben's steps in order.
steps: Reach the Music Hall at 7:10 PM
items.hint: Read the red sign to see what comes before going in. Then think about what you do once you are inside.
items.explain: They arrive at 7:10 PM, wait until the music stops, go in the right door, and then find Row P. The red sign says to wait, and the blue sign shows the door for rows N to Z.

items.prompt: Ben wants to eat his chips before he plays. Where should he eat them?
options: At the snack tables
Next to the racing game
While he plays his first game
Walking around the game area
items.hint: Find the sign about food. Then find a sign that shows a place where food is OK.
items.explain: He eats them at the snack tables. The red sign says NO FOOD OR DRINKS PAST THIS POINT, and the blue sign shows the SNACK TABLES.

items.prompt: It is 10:30 AM. Leo and Ben are at the door. Tap the sign that tells them they must wait.
items.hint: Look for a sign with times on it. Compare those times with 10:30 AM.
items.explain: The green sign says OPEN 11 AM TO 9 PM. At 10:30 AM the arcade is not open yet, so they wait 30 minutes.

items.prompt: Sam and Grandma Rose are in the Dinosaur Hall. Her knee is sore, so she wants to skip the stairs. They want to see the Ice Age Room next. Tap the way they should go.
items.hint: Find the Ice Age Room's row and read which ways reach it. Then check which of those also reach Floor 2.
items.explain: They take Lift A. The Lower level row lists only Lift A and the West Stairs, and Grandma Rose wants to skip the stairs. Lift B does not stop at the lower level.

items.prompt: Maya has lunch at the Sky Café on Floor 3. Then she wants to leave the museum. What should she do?
options: Take the East Stairs down to Floor 1, then use an exit
Take Lift A down to Floor 1, then use an exit
Take Lift B down to Floor 1, then use an exit
Find the exit on Floor 3, next to the café
items.hint: Find the Floor 3 row and read the ways to reach it. Then read the note to find where the exits are.
items.explain: She takes Lift A down to Floor 1. The Floor 3 row lists only Lift A, and the note says exits are on Floor 1 only.

items.prompt: Ana is in the Dinosaur Hall and needs a restroom. Tap the floor with the nearest restrooms.
items.hint: Find every row with the restroom symbol. Then count how many floors away from Floor 2 each one is.
items.explain: Floor 1 has the nearest restrooms. The 🚻 symbol is on Floor 1 and on the lower level, and Floor 1 is just one floor below the Dinosaur Hall.

items.prompt: One red pennant is flying. Leo planned to paddle his kayak around the harbor. What should he do?
options: Paddle out, because one pennant is only a small warning
Keep his kayak on shore today
Paddle out, but stay inside the harbor
Wait until the ferry leaves, then paddle out
items.hint: Find the row for one red pennant. Read the last column and look for the kind of boat Leo has.
items.explain: Leo keeps his kayak on shore. The one red pennant row says kayaks, canoes and paddleboards stay on shore. Staying inside the harbor is the rule for small sailboats.

items.prompt: Sam planned to take the morning ferry to Story Woods. At the dock, he sees one square red flag with a black square in the middle. What should he do?
options: Wait on the dock until the ferry comes
Get on the ferry, but expect it to leave late
Make a new plan for the day, because the ferry does not run
Ask to ride in a small sailboat instead
items.hint: Match the flag Sam sees to a row in the table. Then read every rule in that row.
items.explain: Sam makes a new plan. The square red flag with a black square is a storm warning, and that row says the ferry does not run and people stay off the dock. Leaving late is the rule for two red pennants.

items.prompt: The wind is blowing at 45 miles per hour. Tap the row for the flag that should be flying.
items.hint: Read the Wind column. Find the range that 45 fits inside.
items.explain: Two red pennants should be flying. The gale warning row covers wind from 39 to 54 miles per hour, and 45 is between those numbers.

items.prompt: Inside the tunnel, the yellow path goes under a LOW ROOF sign. Beside it, a side tunnel with a higher roof has a chain across it. What should Maya do?
options: Step over the chain and use the side tunnel, because its roof is higher
Stay on the yellow path and duck carefully under the low roof
Turn back to the gate, because the yellow path is closed
Wait at the chain until a guide takes it down
items.hint: Decide which signs tell you to keep out and which signs only tell you to be careful. A yellow triangle is a warning.
items.explain: Maya stays on the yellow path and ducks carefully. The yellow LOW ROOF sign only warns her to be careful, but the red sign says AREA CLOSED: DO NOT GO PAST THE CHAIN.

items.prompt: Ben stops to look at a shiny rock. When he looks up, he cannot see his group. What should he do?
options: Walk past the chain to look for them
Go back to the gate and wait outside
Wait at the nearest green light
Turn off his helmet lamp and listen
items.hint: Find the sign for someone who cannot see their group. Read what it tells you to do.
items.explain: Ben waits at the nearest green light. The green sign says LOST YOUR GROUP? WAIT AT A GREEN LIGHT.

items.prompt: What does each sign tell you? Put each sign in the right box.
bins: Where to go or not go

cards.text: HARD HATS ON PAST THIS GATE
TURN ON YOUR HELMET LAMP AT THE TUNNEL
AREA CLOSED: DO NOT GO PAST THE CHAIN
LOST YOUR GROUP? WAIT AT A GREEN LIGHT

items.hint: Read each sign. Ask: is it about something I wear or carry, or about a place?
items.explain: The hard hat and helmet lamp signs tell you what to wear or use. The yellow path, the chain and the green light signs tell you where to go or not go.

items.prompt: Ana is at the Goat Yard at 1:50 PM. She wants to hear the whole otter feeding talk and then come back to pet the goats. Which plan works?
options: Walk to Otter Creek now, hear the talk, and be back at the goats at about 2:25 PM
Stay with the goats until 2:00 PM, then walk to Otter Creek for the talk
Hear the talk, take one train trip, and be back at the goats at about 3:15 PM
Stay with the goats now and hear the next talk at 4:00 PM
items.hint: Add the walking time to 1:50 PM and compare it with the talk time. Then add the talk and the walk back, and check the Goat Yard's hours.
items.explain: The first plan works. She reaches Otter Creek at about 1:55 PM, the talk runs from 2:00 to 2:20 PM, and the walk back gets her to the goats at about 2:25 PM, before the yard closes at 3:00 PM.

items.prompt: Leo's family will be at the park from 10:00 AM until 3:30 PM. Tap the place that will be closed for their whole visit.
items.hint: Read the times in every row. Find the place that opens only after 3:30 PM.
items.explain: The Bat House is closed for their whole visit. It opens at 4:00 PM, after they leave. The Goat Yard closes at 3:00 PM, but it is open for most of their visit.

items.prompt: It is 4:35 PM, and Sam is at the Main Gate. He wanted one train trip around the park before he goes home. What should he do?
options: Wait for the 5:00 PM train
Wait for the 4:45 PM train
Walk to see the animals instead, because the last train left at 4:30 PM
Catch the 4:30 PM train, because trains run until 4:30 PM
items.hint: Read the Park Train row. Find the time of the last train, and compare it with 4:35 PM.
items.explain: Sam walks instead. The Park Train row says trains leave from 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM, so the 4:30 PM train was the last one, and it has already left.

items.prompt: Priya plays the cello in the String Orchestra. What time should she be in the Warm-up Room?
items.hint: Find her band's start time in the note under the table. Then use the Warm-up Room row to work out how much earlier to arrive.
items.explain: She should be there at 6:45 PM. The note says the String Orchestra starts at 7:15 PM, and the Warm-up Room row says to arrive 30 minutes before. 6:00 PM is the time for the Jazz Band.

items.prompt: Ben plays the keyboard in the Jazz Band. He is in the Warm-up Room with his keyboard in its case, and his phone is on quiet mode. What should he do before he walks to the Stage Door?
options: Switch his phone off, then carry his keyboard in its case onto the stage
Switch his phone off, take out his keyboard, and leave the case in the Case Room
Keep his phone on quiet, take out his keyboard, and leave the case in the Case Room
Take out his keyboard, and leave the case and his quiet phone by the Stage Door
items.hint: Two rows tell Ben what to do before he goes on stage. Read each one to the end.
items.explain: He switches his phone all the way off and leaves the case in the Case Room. The Phones row says quiet mode is not enough, and the Case Room row says to leave your case there before you go on stage.

items.prompt: While the String Orchestra is playing, Ben needs to go through a backstage door to reach the Case Room. A red light is on over the door. What should he do?
options: Open the door slowly so nobody hears it
Wait quietly in the hall until the light turns green, then walk through quietly
Walk through quickly while the music is loud
Wait in the hall until the stage manager calls the Jazz Band
items.hint: Read the rows for both colors of light. Decide what Ben does now and what he does later.
items.explain: He waits quietly until the light turns green, then walks through quietly. The red light row says to keep the door closed and wait, and the green light row says you may walk through quietly.

items.prompt: Maya wants to touch a crab. Tap the tank she should go to.
items.hint: Read the sign on each tank. Find the word that means you may touch.
items.explain: Maya goes to the touch tank. Its green sign says TOUCH TANK.

items.prompt: Priya wants to touch a sea star. How should she touch it?
options: With two fingers
With her whole hand
With a stick
items.hint: Find the sign that tells you how to touch.
items.explain: She touches it with two fingers. The white sign says TOUCH WITH TWO FINGERS.

items.prompt: Leo wants to feel a dinosaur bone. Which bone can he touch?
options: The real fossil
The copy
items.hint: Read both signs. Find the sign that says you may touch.
items.explain: Leo can touch the copy. Its green sign says PLEASE TOUCH.

items.prompt: What does the red sign tell Leo to do?
options: Touch the real fossil gently
Pick up the real fossil
Keep his hands off the real fossil
items.hint: Read every word on the red sign.
items.explain: Leo keeps his hands off the real fossil. The red sign says DO NOT TOUCH.

items.prompt: Tap the way Sam and Grandma Rose should go.
items.hint: Think about what they want to ride. Find the sign with that word.
items.explain: They go up the stairs. The sign says TRAINS: UP THE STAIRS.

items.prompt: Grandma Rose says, "Next time, we will take the bus." Which way will they go for the bus?
options: Up the stairs
Left
Right
items.hint: Find the sign that says BUSES. Read where it tells you to go.
items.explain: They turn left. The sign says BUSES: TURN LEFT.

items.prompt: Tap the place where Ana and Ben can sled today.
items.hint: Read the sign at each place. Check which place is for sleds, and which places are closed or for something else.
items.explain: They sled on the hill. Its green sign says SLED HILL OPEN.

items.prompt: Ben wants to slide across the frozen pond. What do the signs tell him?
options: The pond is closed, because the ice is thin
The pond is open after lunch
The pond is only for sleds
items.hint: Find the sign about the pond. Read all of it.
items.explain: The pond is closed. The red sign says POND CLOSED: THIN ICE.

items.prompt: Ana's toes are cold after sledding. Where can she go to warm up?
options: The pond
The warming hut
The icy path
items.hint: Think about what Ana needs. Then read each sign and ask which place could help her.
items.explain: She goes to the warming hut. The blue sign says WARMING HUT.

items.prompt: What should Priya do with her rover first?
options: Drive it on the test mat
Drive it on a table
Put it on the charging shelf
items.hint: Read the story to find what is wrong with the rover. Then find the sign that can help.
items.explain: She puts it on the charging shelf. The battery is low, and the CHARGING SHELF sign shows where to charge it.

items.prompt: The rover is charged now. Tap the place where Priya should drive it.
items.hint: Read the sign at each place. Find the sign that says where robots can drive.
items.explain: She drives it on the test mat. Its green sign says DRIVE ROBOTS HERE, and the red sign says NO DRIVING ON THE TABLES.

items.prompt: Priya starts to build a new arm for her rover. What must she put on?
options: Safety glasses
A hard hat
A helmet lamp
items.hint: Find the sign that talks about building.
items.explain: She puts on safety glasses. The round blue sign says SAFETY GLASSES ON WHEN YOU BUILD.

items.prompt: Tap the door Maya should open.
items.hint: Read the story to see what kind of room Maya needs. Then read the sign on each door.
items.explain: Maya opens the Room 2 door. She needs an empty room, and its sign says EMPTY.

items.prompt: Leo goes into the drum room to practice. What should he do first?
options: Knock on Room 1
Put in ear plugs
Take off his shoes
items.hint: Find the sign on the drum room door. Read what it tells you to do.
items.explain: He puts in ear plugs. The drum room sign says WEAR EAR PLUGS.

items.prompt: What does IN USE on the Room 1 sign mean?
options: The room is broken
The room is for drums
Someone is using the room now
items.hint: Think about what the words IN USE say about a room. Compare them with the Room 2 sign.
items.explain: IN USE means someone is using Room 1 now, so Maya picks another room. It is the red sign.

items.prompt: Which aisle should Ben go to?
options: Aisle 1
Aisle 2
Aisle 3
items.hint: Find what Ben wants in the story. Then find the aisle sign with the same words.
items.explain: Ben goes to Aisle 2. Its sign says BOARD GAMES.

items.prompt: Ben picks a game. Tap the sign that shows where he can buy it.
items.hint: Think about what you do when you buy something in a shop. Then find a sign about it.
items.explain: The PAY HERE sign shows where Ben can buy his game. It is the yellow sign.

items.prompt: Ana wants to play a video game before she buys it. Where should she go?
options: To the TRY A GAME HERE spot
To Aisle 1
To the PAY HERE desk
items.hint: Ana wants to play first. Find the sign about playing a game in the shop.
items.explain: She goes to the TRY A GAME HERE spot. Aisle 1 sells video games, but the green sign shows where to try one.

items.prompt: What should Sam do with Pixel?
options: Walk Pixel along the paths
Stay outside the garden with Pixel
Let Pixel sniff the plants
items.hint: Find the sign with a dog on it. Read what it says.
items.explain: Sam stays outside the garden with Pixel. The red sign says NO DOGS IN THE GARDEN.

items.prompt: Maya walks to the flowers and sees the yellow sign. What should she do?
options: Pick the flowers quickly
Run past the flowers
Walk calmly and watch for bees
items.hint: Read the yellow sign. A yellow triangle is a warning to be careful.
items.explain: Maya walks calmly and watches for bees. The yellow sign says BEES AT WORK, so bees are near the flowers.

items.prompt: Ana has these things on her tray. Put each one in the right bin.
items.hint: Read each bin sign word by word. A thing that is not named on the Recycling or Compost sign goes in the bin for everything else.
items.explain: The can and the bottle go in Recycling. The apple core and the napkin go in Compost. The plastic fork and the chip bag are not named on those two signs, so they go in Trash.

items.prompt: Leo still has some milk in his plastic bottle. What should he do?
options: Pour the milk out in the sink, then put the bottle in Recycling
Put the bottle in Recycling with the milk still inside
Put the bottle in Compost, because milk is food
Put the bottle in Trash, because it is not empty
items.hint: Two signs are about this bottle. Find the one that says what to do first. Then find the bin for bottles.
items.explain: Leo pours the milk out in the sink, then puts the bottle in Recycling. The white sign says POUR OUT DRINKS IN THE SINK FIRST, and the blue sign takes plastic bottles.

items.prompt: Ben has a banana peel and an empty soda can. Where does each one go?
options: Both in Recycling
The peel in Compost, the can in Recycling
Both in Compost
The peel in Trash, the can in Recycling
items.hint: Check each thing on its own. Match it to the words on a bin sign.
items.explain: The banana peel is a food scrap, so it goes in Compost, and the can goes in Recycling. The green sign and the blue sign name them.

items.prompt: The board shows ❄️. Where is recess, and what should Sam wear?
options: Outside on the field, in sneakers
Inside in the gym, in boots
Outside on the blacktop, in boots
Inside in the library, in sneakers
items.hint: Find the snow symbol in the key. Read both parts of its Recess box.
items.explain: Recess is outside on the blacktop, and Sam wears boots. The ❄️ row says Outside on the blacktop. Wear boots.

items.prompt: The board shows ☀️, and the class is on the field. They hear thunder at 12:10 PM. The last thunder is at 12:20 PM. When may they play outside again?
items.hint: Find the row for thunder. Then add its number of minutes to the time of the last thunder.
items.explain: They may play outside again at 12:50 PM. The thunder row says outdoor games stop until 30 minutes after the last thunder, and 30 minutes after 12:20 PM is 12:50 PM.

items.prompt: The board shows 🥶. Ana wanted to play soccer at recess. What is a good new plan?
options: Play soccer on the field
Play soccer on the blacktop in boots
Play soccer in the gym
Bring a book or a quiet game to the library
items.hint: Find the symbol from the board in the key. Then think about what fits in that place.
items.explain: Ana brings a book or a quiet game. The 🥶 row says recess is inside in the library, and soccer does not fit there.

items.prompt: Ana and Ben walk in through the main gate. Where is Field 4?
options: Right next to the gate, to the east
Right next to the gate, to the west
Two boxes north of the gate
Just north of the gate, behind the snack stand
items.hint: Find the main gate on the map. Then look at the boxes beside it, and use the column names.
items.explain: Field 4 is right next to the gate, to the east. In the South row, the main gate is in the Middle column, and Field 4 is in the East column.

items.prompt: Ben's water bottle is empty before the game. Where should he go?
options: The 🚻 box, on the west side
The 🚰 box, just north of Field 4
The 🅿️ box, in the north
The 🍿 box, just north of the gate
items.hint: Find the symbol that means drinking water. Then see which box it is in.
items.explain: He goes to the 🚰 box. It is in the Center row and the East column, just north of Field 4.

items.prompt: Leo wants to practice on an open field right next to the restrooms. Which field should he use?
options: Field 2
Field 3
Field 1
Field 4
items.hint: Find the restrooms. Look at the boxes just above and just below them. Then check if each field there is open.
items.explain: Leo uses Field 1. Field 1 and Field 3 are both next to the restrooms, but Field 3 is closed for new grass.

items.prompt: Priya and Maya get to the doors at 1:05 PM. What will happen?
options: They go in quietly and find seats
They watch the end of the 1:00 PM show
They go in at 1:40 PM
They wait for the 3:00 PM show
items.hint: Compare the time they arrive with the show times. Then read the red sign about the doors.
items.explain: They wait for the 3:00 PM show. The 1:00 PM show has already started, and the red sign says DOORS CLOSE WHEN THE SHOW STARTS.

items.prompt: The 3:00 PM show starts on time. When will it end?
items.hint: Find the sign that says how long a show lasts. Add that to the start time.
items.explain: It ends at 3:40 PM. The white sign says EACH SHOW LASTS 40 MINUTES, and 40 minutes after 3:00 PM is 3:40 PM.

items.prompt: Maya wants to text her dad during the show. Tap the sign that tells her to wait until the show ends.
items.hint: Texting uses a phone. Find the sign about phones.
items.explain: The round red sign says PHONES OFF DURING THE SHOW. Maya can text her dad after the show.

items.prompt: Maya wants to hold a rock and feel how heavy it is. Tap the place where she can do that.

sign.text: MINERAL ROOM: PLEASE TOUCH THE ROCKS ON THE TABLES
UV ROOM: SHUT THE DOOR SO THE ROCKS GLOW IN THE DARK
PANNING TABLE: ROLL UP YOUR SLEEVES

items.hint: Look for a sign that says you may touch. Check the red sign too.
items.explain: She goes to the Mineral Room. Its sign says PLEASE TOUCH THE ROCKS ON THE TABLES. The glass cases are look only.

items.prompt: Sam walks into the UV Room. What should he do right after he goes in?
options: Shut the door behind him
Leave the door open so light comes in
Turn on the room lights
Roll up his sleeves
items.hint: Find the sign for the UV Room. Read what it says to do with the door, and why.
items.explain: He shuts the door behind him. The UV Room sign says to shut the door so the rocks glow in the dark.

items.prompt: Ben is wearing a long-sleeved shirt. He wants to try the panning table. What should he do first?
options: Put on gloves
Roll up his sleeves
Wash his hands
Change his shirt
items.hint: Find the sign for the panning table. Read what it tells you to do.
items.explain: He rolls up his sleeves. The green sign says PANNING TABLE: ROLL UP YOUR SLEEVES.

items.prompt: Tap the gate Sam and Pixel should use.
items.hint: Find Pixel's weight in the story. Compare it with the number on each sign.
items.explain: They use the right gate. Pixel weighs 25 pounds, and the LARGE DOGS sign is for dogs 20 pounds and up.

items.prompt: Put Sam's steps at the two gates in order.
items.hint: Read the yellow sign. It tells you which gate must be closed before the other one opens.
items.explain: Sam opens the first gate, walks in with Pixel, closes the first gate, and then opens the second gate. The yellow sign says to close the first gate before you open the second gate.

items.prompt: Sam brought a sandwich for his lunch. What should he do with it?
options: Eat it inside the dog park
Share it with Pixel in the park
Eat it before he goes in or after he comes out
Throw it away at the gate
items.hint: Find the sign about food. Then think about where Sam can eat instead.
items.explain: He eats it outside the park, before or after his visit. The red sign says NO PEOPLE FOOD IN THE DOG PARK.

items.prompt: Tap the platform where Sam and Grandma Rose should wait today.
items.hint: First find the platform for Lantern Peaks trains. Then check the yellow sign for a change today.
items.explain: They wait on Platform 3. Lantern Peaks trains use Platform 2, but the yellow sign says Platform 2 trains leave from Platform 3 today.

items.prompt: The train is coming in. Where should Sam stand?
options: On the yellow line
At the edge of the platform
In front of the yellow line
Behind the yellow line
items.hint: Find the warning sign. Read the word that comes just before "the yellow line".
items.explain: Sam stands behind the yellow line. The yellow triangle sign says STAND BEHIND THE YELLOW LINE.

items.prompt: Ana wants a train that stops at every station around the harbor. Which platform should she go to?
options: Platform 1
Platform 2
Platform 3
items.hint: Look for the sign with words about stops.
items.explain: She goes to Platform 1. Its sign says HARBOR LOOP, ALL STOPS.

items.prompt: Ana cannot eat peanuts or tree nuts. Which of these treats is safe for her?
options: Apple oat bar
Banana walnut bread
Peanut butter cookie
Chocolate almond cookie
items.hint: Use the key to find the nut symbol. Then check each treat's row for it.
items.explain: The apple oat bar is safe for Ana. Its row has no 🥜, and the key says 🥜 means the treat has nuts.

items.prompt: Leo wants to try a treat that is new this week and has no milk. Which treat should he pick?
options: Chocolate almond cookie
Apple oat bar
Lemon rice cake
Fruit cup
items.hint: Find the rows with the symbol for new this week. Then check which of them has no milk symbol.
items.explain: Leo picks the apple oat bar. It has ⭐ for new this week and no 🥛. The chocolate almond cookie is new too, but it has milk.

items.prompt: A customer cannot eat wheat. Put each treat in the right box.
items.hint: Find the wheat symbol in the key. Then check each treat's row for it.
items.explain: The muffin, the oat bar, the banana walnut bread and the peanut butter cookie have 🌾, so they have wheat. The lemon rice cake and the fruit cup have no 🌾.

items.prompt: Sam is riding Route 1 and wants to get to Story Woods. Which symbol should he look for along the red line?
options: ⚪ White dot
🌙 Moon
⭐ Star
🟢 Green line
items.hint: Story Woods is on a different route. Find the symbol that shows where you can change routes.
items.explain: He looks for a ⭐ star. Story Woods is on Route 2, the blue line, and the key says a star is a transfer stop where you change to another route.

items.prompt: Maya is riding home at 9:00 PM. Tap the row that tells her which stops the bus will use.
items.hint: Look for a row with a time in it. Compare that time with 9:00 PM.
items.explain: The Moon row says that after 8:00 PM, buses stop only at moon stops. 9:00 PM is after 8:00 PM.

items.prompt: Part of the blue line on Sam's map is dashed. What does that tell him?
options: Route 2 stops running there today
That part of Route 2 runs only at night
That part is a walking path
Route 2 takes a different way there because of road work
items.hint: Find the row for a dashed line. Read its meaning.
items.explain: Route 2 takes a different way there. The key says a dashed line means the route moved for road work.

items.prompt: Which washer setting matches Ana's tag?
options: Cold water, no bleach
Warm water, with bleach
Cold water, with bleach
Warm water, no bleach
items.hint: Find the tub symbol on Ana's tag in the note, then find its row. Do the same for the triangle.
items.explain: She uses cold water and no bleach. Her tag has a tub with 1 dot, which means wash in cold water, and a triangle with an X, which means do not use bleach.

items.prompt: The jersey is washed and wet. How should Ana dry it?
options: In the dryer on low heat
Hang it up to dry
In the dryer, then iron it on low heat
Iron it until it is dry
items.hint: Ana's tag has two square symbols. Find both rows and put them together.
items.explain: She hangs it up to dry. Her tag has a square with a circle and an X, which means do not put it in a dryer, and a square with a curved line at the top, which means hang it up to dry.

items.prompt: The jersey has wrinkles after it dries. Tap the row that matches the iron symbol on Ana's tag.
items.hint: Find the iron symbol in the note about Ana's tag. Then find the row with exactly the same words.
items.explain: The Iron with an X row matches Ana's tag. It means do not iron, so she leaves the wrinkles. The Iron with 1 dot row is not on her tag.

items.prompt: Leo is a strong skier. He wants the most difficult run that is open right now. Which run should he pick?
options: Eagle Drop
Summit Chute
Fox Trail
Pine Run
items.hint: Use the key to rank the symbols from easiest to hardest. Then cross out every run that is closed today.
items.explain: Leo picks Fox Trail. Eagle Drop and Summit Chute are harder, but both are closed today, so the blue square on Fox Trail is the hardest symbol left.

items.prompt: Maya is skiing for the first time. She wants an easy run, and she wants to ride the chair lift. Which run fits her?
options: Bunny Slope
Fox Trail
Eagle Drop
Pine Run
items.hint: Find every run with the easiest symbol. Then check the Lift column for each one.
items.explain: Pine Run fits. It has the green circle for easiest, and its lift is the chair lift. The Bunny Slope is easy too, but it uses a rope tow.

items.prompt: At 2:00 PM, the wind sign changes to 40 miles per hour. Sam is at the bottom of Pine Run. What can he do now?
options: Ski the Bunny Slope or go sledding, because the chair lift has stopped
Ride the chair lift up Pine Run, because Pine Run is open
Ride the top lift up to Summit Chute
Wait at the chair lift until the Sled Hill closes at 3:00 PM
items.hint: Read the note about wind and compare 40 with its number. Then find the runs that do not need the chair lift or the top lift.
items.explain: Sam can ski the Bunny Slope or go sledding. The note says the lifts stop when the wind is over 35 miles per hour. The Bunny Slope uses a rope tow, and you walk up the Sled Hill.

items.prompt: Ana wants to take her bike to Lantern Peaks. Which train should she take?
items.hint: Find every train to Lantern Peaks. Then use the key to read the bike symbols in the Notes column.
items.explain: She takes the 11:15 AM train. The 10:50 AM train also goes to Lantern Peaks, but it shows 🚫🚲, which means no bikes. The 11:15 AM train allows bikes in car 4.

items.prompt: Sam wants to get to Story Woods as soon as he can. Which train will leave first?
options: The 11:05 AM train, which will now leave at 11:25 AM
The 11:20 AM train
The 10:50 AM train
The 11:15 AM train
items.hint: Find both Story Woods trains. Add the delay to the first one, then compare the two times.
items.explain: The 11:20 AM train leaves first. The 11:05 AM train is delayed 20 minutes, so it will leave at 11:25 AM, which is after 11:20 AM.

items.prompt: Maya wants to read in a quiet car on her way to Story Woods. Tap the row for the train she should take.
items.hint: Use the key to find the quiet car symbol. Then find the Story Woods row that has it.
items.explain: Maya should take the 11:20 AM train to Story Woods. Its Notes say 🤫 in car 1, and the key says 🤫 means a quiet car.

items.prompt: Ben reaches the station doors at 10:47 AM. He wants to ride to Lantern Peaks, and he has no bike. What should he do?
options: Catch the 10:50 AM train, because he has 3 minutes
Go to Platform 1 for the 10:50 AM train
Take the 11:15 AM train, because the walk to Platform 2 takes 5 minutes
Take the 11:05 AM train, because it leaves sooner
items.hint: Add the walking time in the note to 10:47 AM. Then compare it with the times of the Lantern Peaks trains.
items.explain: He takes the 11:15 AM train. The note says the walk to Platform 2 takes 5 minutes, so he would reach the platform at 10:52 AM, after the 10:50 AM train has left. The 11:05 AM train goes to Story Woods.

items.prompt: Ana walks in at the entrance. She wanted to see the turtles first. What is her best plan?
options: Walk to the Turtle Pool, north-east of the entrance
Wait at the Front Desk until the Turtle Pool opens at 11:00 AM
Look at the turtles from the Seal Show
Visit another room first, because the Turtle Pool is closed today
items.hint: Find the Turtle Pool on the map. Then read the note to see if anything about it is different today.
items.explain: She visits another room. The note says the Turtle Pool is closed today for cleaning. The 11:00 AM time in the note is for the penguins.

items.prompt: Priya is at Penguin Beach at 1:20 PM. She wants to see a seal show before the aquarium closes. Which show can she see?
options: The 3:00 PM show
The 1:00 PM show
The 11:00 AM show
The 4:00 PM show
items.hint: Find the seal show times in the note. Cross out any time that has already passed.
items.explain: She can see the 3:00 PM show. The note lists seal shows at 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM, and 1:00 PM has already passed. 4:00 PM is when the aquarium closes.

items.prompt: Leo is at the restrooms. He wants to walk through the Shark Tunnel. Where should he go in?
options: At the tunnel's north end
At the tunnel's south end, right next to the restrooms
Through Penguin Beach
Through the Café
items.hint: Read the note about the Shark Tunnel. Then use the map to see which side of the tunnel touches the restrooms.
items.explain: He goes in at the south end, right next to the restrooms. The note says to go in at the south end only, and on the map the restrooms are just south of the Shark Tunnel.

items.prompt: Leo plays the drums in Ms. Gray's Grade 7 band. He also wants to play in the Drum Circle. Which time works for both?
options: 12:00 PM to about 12:25 PM, then walk to the Main Stage
12:30 PM to 1:00 PM
1:00 PM to 2:00 PM
items.hint: Find when Leo's band plays and for how long. Then find when the Drum Circle is open, and leave time to walk.
items.explain: He plays in the Drum Circle from 12:00 PM to about 12:25 PM, then walks 5 minutes to the Main Stage. His band plays from 12:30 PM to 1:00 PM, and the Drum Circle closes at 1:00 PM.

items.prompt: Maya wants to hear the jazz group at the Tent Stage, but very loud music bothers her. What can she do?
options: Listen to the jazz group from inside the Quiet Tent
Ask to sit on the Main Stage
Pick up free ear plugs at the tent door, then listen
Go to the Drum Circle instead
items.hint: Read the Tent Stage row to the end. Then check what the Quiet Tent allows.
items.explain: She picks up free ear plugs at the tent door. The Tent Stage row says the music is very loud and the ear plugs are free. The Quiet Tent has no music inside, so she would not hear the jazz group there.

items.prompt: Ana plays the trumpet. Today she wants to try a cello for the first time. What should she do?
options: Bring a cello from home
Ask Ms. Gray's band for a 30-minute turn
Go to the Main Stage at 12:30 PM
Sign up at the Try-It Tent door for a 10-minute turn
items.hint: Find the place where you can try an instrument. Read its rules from start to end.
items.explain: She signs up at the Try-It Tent door. That row says each person gets one 10-minute turn, and you sign up at the door.

items.prompt: Ben arrives at 1:15 PM. He wanted to play in the Kart Racing tournament. What can he do?
options: Sign up for Block Builder instead, because Kart Racing sign-up closed at 1:00 PM
Sign up for Kart Racing at the Sign-up Desk now
Go to the Tournament Stage at 2:00 PM and sign up there
Wait until 2:00 PM, then sign up for Kart Racing
items.hint: Find the Kart Racing start time in the note. Work out when its sign-up closed, and compare that with 1:15 PM.
items.explain: He can sign up for Block Builder instead. Kart Racing starts at 2:00 PM, so its sign-up closed at 1:00 PM. Block Builder starts at 4:00 PM, so its sign-up is open until 3:00 PM.

items.prompt: Leo has a big backpack and a slice of pizza. He wants to try a new game. What should he do?
options: Eat the pizza while he waits in line for Try New Games
Eat at the Food Court and leave his backpack at Bag Check, then go to Try New Games
Leave his backpack at Phone Charging, then eat at the Board Game Tables
Take his backpack and his pizza to Try New Games
items.hint: The note has one rule about food and one rule about big bags. Follow both before he plays.
items.explain: He eats at the Food Court and leaves his backpack at Bag Check first. The note says food and drinks stay in the Food Court, and big bags go to Bag Check.

items.prompt: Maya is at the Main Doors. She wants to play board games. Which way should she walk?
options: Left, to the front corner of the hall
Right, past Bag Check, to the back corner
Straight ahead, past Try New Games, to the back of the hall
Straight ahead, and stop in the center of the hall
items.hint: Find the Main Doors and the Board Game Tables on the plan. Check which column and which row each one is in.
items.explain: She walks straight ahead to the back of the hall. The Main Doors and the Board Game Tables are both in the Middle column, and the tables are in the Back row, past Try New Games.

items.prompt: Priya's match is at 2:30 PM. At 2:15 PM, the team wants to test the robot, but the test field light is red. What should they do?
options: Drive onto the test field now, because the match is soon
Wait at the test field for the green light, even if it is after 2:30 PM
Test the robot on the match line
Go to the match line by 2:20 PM, even if they cannot test first
items.hint: Work out when the team must be at the match line. Then decide what to do if the light stays red.
items.explain: They go to the match line by 2:20 PM. The green sign says to be there 10 minutes before the match, and the red sign says to wait for the green light before testing.

items.prompt: Sam came to watch Priya's team. He does not have a team badge. Where should he watch from?
options: Outside the pit area
Inside the pit, if he wears safety glasses
At the charging table
On the match line with the team
items.hint: Find the sign about who may go into the pit. Check whether Sam has what it asks for.
items.explain: He watches from outside the pit area. The blue sign says PIT AREA: TEAM BADGES ONLY, and Sam has no badge.

items.prompt: The team takes their robot from the pit to the test field. Put their steps in order.
steps: Carry the robot to the test field
Switch the robot on and drive it
items.hint: One sign says what to do before you carry a robot. Another sign says what to wait for at the test field.
items.explain: They switch the robot off, carry it to the test field, wait for the green light, and then switch it on and drive. The white sign and the red sign give these steps.

items.prompt: The team wants to charge a battery during lunch. Their adult helper is going to lunch with them. What should they do?
options: Leave the battery charging while everyone eats
Charge it after lunch, when an adult can stay at the charging table
Charge it in the pit with no adult, because they have badges
Charge it on the test field
items.hint: Read the yellow sign. Check who must stay with a battery while it charges.
items.explain: They charge it after lunch, when an adult can stay with it. The yellow sign says an adult must stay with charging batteries, and their helper will be at lunch.

items.prompt: Maya is digging with a trowel in a green area. Her trowel scrapes something hard and brown that looks like a bone. What should she do next?
options: Keep digging with the trowel, because green means no fossils
Put a red flag beside it and dig it out with the trowel
Stop, put a yellow flag beside it, and tell a team member
Switch to a soft brush and dig it out by herself
items.hint: Read the note under the key. It tells you what to do when you find a bone in a green area.
items.explain: She stops, puts a yellow flag beside it, and tells a team member. The note gives these three steps for a bone found in a green area.

items.prompt: Later, Maya works next to a yellow flag. Which tools may she use?
options: A trowel and a brush
A screen box
No tools at all
A soft brush and a wooden pick
items.hint: Find the yellow row. Read the last column, and compare it with the green row.
items.explain: She may use a soft brush and a wooden pick. The Yellow row says those tools only. A trowel is for green areas.

items.prompt: Sam wants to look for tiny fossil teeth without digging in the ground. Tap the row that tells him where to go.
items.hint: Look for a row that talks about small fossils and does not use a digging tool.
items.explain: The White row tells him to go to the sifting station. There he shakes dirt through a screen to find tiny bones and teeth.

items.prompt: The board shows ✨ and 🌕. Maya hopes to see a faint galaxy. What should she expect?
options: The telescope is open, but the galaxy will be hard to see
The telescope is closed tonight
The galaxy will look sharp, because the sky is clear
Dr. Lee will give a sky talk instead
items.hint: Read the row for each symbol on the board. Then put the two rows together.
items.explain: The telescope is open, but the galaxy will be hard to see. The ✨ row says open, and the 🌕 row says faint galaxies are hard to see in bright moonlight.

items.prompt: The board shows ⛅ and 💨. Sam rode the bus up the hill to see Saturn. What should he do?
options: Look at Saturn through the telescope when the clouds move
Plan to come back on another night, because the telescope is closed
Use the telescope from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM
Wait inside the dome until the wind stops
items.hint: Read the note first. Then check each symbol's row for the word Closed.
items.explain: Sam plans to come back another night. The 💨 row says the telescope is closed in strong wind, and the note says that if any row says Closed, the telescope stays closed.

items.prompt: The board shows ☁️. It is 8:10 PM. What can Priya do tonight?
options: Use the telescope until 11:00 PM
Wait for the clouds to pass, then use the telescope at 8:30 PM
Go to Dr. Lee's sky talk in the classroom at 8:30 PM
Go home, because nothing is open tonight
items.hint: Find the cloud symbol in the key. Read the whole Telescope box, not only the first word.
items.explain: Priya can go to Dr. Lee's sky talk at 8:30 PM. The ☁️ row says the telescope is closed and a sky talk happens in the classroom instead.

items.prompt: How can the club cook dinner tonight?
options: On a campfire in the fire ring
Only on a stove at the picnic shelter
With no fire and no stove at all
On the camp stove at their campsite
items.hint: Find the color of the pointer in the second paragraph. Then read the sign part with that color.
items.explain: They cook on the camp stove at their campsite. The pointer is on yellow, and the yellow part says HIGH: NO CAMPFIRES. CAMP STOVES OK.

items.prompt: The next morning is hotter and windier, and the ranger moves the pointer to orange. Where may the club use the stove for breakfast?
options: Only at the picnic shelter
At their campsite
In the fire ring
Nowhere, because stoves are not allowed
items.hint: Find the orange part of the sign. Read every word after NO CAMPFIRES.
items.explain: They may use the stove only at the picnic shelter. The orange part says VERY HIGH: NO CAMPFIRES. STOVES ONLY AT THE PICNIC SHELTER.

items.prompt: Tap the sentence that tells which part of the sign the pointer is on this morning.
items.hint: The pointer is named in more than one sentence. Find the one that gives a color and says this morning.
items.explain: The eighth sentence says the pointer is on the yellow part this morning. That is the detail that tells the club which rule to follow.

items.prompt: Leo's plan was to toast marshmallows over a campfire. Which new plan follows today's sign?
options: Make a small campfire in the fire ring and keep water close
Ask Ms. Ortiz to help him warm a treat on the camp stove
Wait until the pointer moves to red, then make a campfire
Make the campfire at the picnic shelter
items.hint: Find today's part of the sign. Check which kinds of fire it allows.
items.explain: He asks Ms. Ortiz to help him warm a treat on the camp stove. The yellow part says no campfires, but camp stoves are OK. Keeping water close is the rule for the blue part, not the yellow part.

items.prompt: Which way should Priya and her mom go?
options: Turn left and walk to Gate 6
Turn left, then take the train to Gate 14
Take the train, then turn right to Gate 14
Wait by security until their gate is called
items.hint: First find the gate for Flight 212 now. Then find the sign for that group of gates.
items.explain: They take the train, then turn right to Gate 14. The yellow sign says Flight 212 moved from Gate 6 to Gate 14, and the sign for Gates 11 to 20 says to take the train, then turn right.

items.prompt: What time does boarding start, and what should Priya and her mom do now?
options: Boarding starts at 10:45 AM, so they have time to shop first
Boarding starts at 11:00 AM, so they have 45 minutes to spare
Boarding starts at 10:30 AM, but Gate 6 is only 8 minutes away, so they can wait
Boarding starts at 10:30 AM, and the walk takes about 15 minutes, so they should go now
items.hint: Subtract the minutes on the boarding sign from the takeoff time. Then add the walking time for their gate to 10:15 AM.
items.explain: Boarding starts at 10:30 AM, 30 minutes before the 11:00 AM takeoff. The walk to Gates 11 to 20 takes about 15 minutes, so if they leave at 10:15 AM they arrive at about 10:30 AM. They should go now.

items.prompt: Priya needs a restroom on the way. Which restroom is on the same side of the airport as her gate?
options: The one near Gate 16
The one near Gate 9
The one near Gate 6
The one at the security line
items.hint: Find which group of gates her new gate belongs to. Then check which restroom has a gate number in the same group.
items.explain: The restroom near Gate 16 is on her side. Gate 14 and Gate 16 are both in the group Gates 11 to 20. Gate 9 is in the group Gates 1 to 10.

items.prompt: Ana and Ben have tickets for Section 124. How should they get to their seats today?
options: Enter at Gate C, the south gate
Enter at Gate D and take the ramp down
Enter at Gate A and walk around the stadium
Enter at Gate D and ride the elevator up to the upper level
items.hint: Find the row that lists Section 124. Read the whole row to see if anything has changed today.
items.explain: They enter at Gate D and take the ramp down. Section 124 is in the Gate C row, but Gate C is closed today, and that row says to use Gate D and take the ramp down.

items.prompt: Ben wants to bring snacks in his school backpack. What should he do?
options: Carry the backpack in through Gate D
Leave the snacks with the guard at Gate C
Put the snacks in a clear plastic bag no bigger than 12 inches by 12 inches
Hold the backpack in his arms instead of wearing it
items.hint: Find the row about bags. Check what kind of bag is allowed and how big it may be.
items.explain: He puts the snacks in a clear plastic bag, up to 12 inches by 12 inches. The Bags row says only clear plastic bags of that size are allowed.

items.prompt: It is 3:05 PM. The twins are at their gate when Ana remembers that her scarf is in the car. What should they do?
options: Go in now, and get the scarf at halftime
Wait inside until 4:00 PM, then go to the car
Go in at Gate C, because it is closer to the car
Get the scarf first, then go in
items.hint: Find the row about leaving. Think about what happens if they go in first and then leave.
items.explain: They get the scarf first, then go in. The Leaving row says there is no re-entry, so once they leave, they cannot come back in.

items.prompt: Leo has a ticket for Section 105 and an air horn to cheer with. Tap the row with a rule he must follow at his gate.
items.hint: Find the row whose sections include 105. Then read its Notes.
items.explain: The Gate A row lists Sections 101 to 110, and its Notes say no air horns or noisemakers. Leo leaves the horn at home.

items.prompt: On Saturday morning, the app shows 🟠 Watch: strong storms possible this afternoon. Ana's soccer game is at 3:00 PM. What should she do this morning?
options: Get ready, and check the alerts often before the game
Stay inside, away from windows, until the game
Go on with her plans, because the storm is not here yet
Leave extra time to travel to the game
items.hint: Match the alert to its row. Read the What to do box, and check whether the storm is here yet.
items.explain: She gets ready and checks the alerts often. The Watch row says the weather is right for a storm, but it is not here yet, so you get ready. Staying inside is the rule for a Warning.

items.prompt: At 3:00 PM, the app shows 🔴 Warning for Harbor Town until 5:00 PM. Leo planned to skate at 4:00 PM. What should he do?
options: Skate at 4:00 PM, but leave extra time
Stay inside, away from windows, and skate another time after the warning ends
Go to the skate park early, at 3:30 PM
Charge his phone, then skate at 4:00 PM
items.hint: Find the row for a Warning. Compare the time the warning ends with Leo's plan.
items.explain: Leo stays inside, away from windows, and skates after the warning ends. The Warning row says to stay inside until the warning ends, and this one lasts until 5:00 PM.

items.prompt: The app shows 🟡 Advisory: thick fog in Story Woods, 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Sam's bus leaves Harbor Town at 9:00 AM and reaches Story Woods at 9:30 AM. What should he do?
options: Stay home, because fog is a storm
Go as planned, because he lives in Harbor Town
Leave extra time, because his trip is inside the place and time of the advisory
Wait inside, away from windows, until 10:00 AM
items.hint: Read the note under the chart. Check the place and the time of the advisory against Sam's trip.
items.explain: He leaves extra time. His bus is in Story Woods at 9:30 AM, which is inside the advisory's place and time, and the Advisory row says to take care and leave extra time to travel.

items.prompt: Does each card go with a Watch or a Warning? Put each card in the right box.

cards.text: A storm could form later today
Charge phones and check the alerts often

items.hint: Decide if each card is about a storm that might come or a storm that is here. Use the Watch row and the Warning row.
items.explain: The orange alert, a storm that could form later today, and charging phones go with a Watch. The red alert, a storm starting now, and staying inside away from windows go with a Warning.

items.prompt: Sam sees two yellow blazes on a tree, one above the other. The top one is shifted to the left. What does this tell him?
options: Keep walking straight ahead
The Yellow Trail ends here
The Yellow Trail is about to turn right
The Yellow Trail is about to turn left
items.hint: Find the paragraph about directions. Read what two blazes mean, then what it means when the top one is shifted.
items.explain: The Yellow Trail is about to turn left. The second paragraph says two blazes warn of a turn, and a top blaze shifted to the left means the turn is to the left.

items.prompt: Sam and Maya reach the first fork and read the notice. What is their best new plan?
options: Hike the Blue Trail to the lookout instead
Take the Yellow Trail and climb over the fallen tree
Wait at the fork until the rangers move the tree
Follow the yellow blazes, but walk around the tree through the woods
items.hint: Read the third paragraph to find what changed today. Then check which trail at the fork is still open.
items.explain: They hike the Blue Trail to the lookout instead. The notice says the Yellow Trail is closed past the fork, and the signpost shows the Blue Trail going straight to the lookout.

items.prompt: Tap the sentence that tells what Sam and Maya will do if they lose the trail.
items.hint: Look in the last paragraph for a rule they made before they started.
items.explain: The last sentence says they will turn around and walk back to the last blaze they saw if they walk for five minutes without seeing one.

items.prompt: How far will Sam and Maya walk from the first fork to the lookout and back to the fork?
options: 1.2 miles
2 miles
2.4 miles
3.2 miles
items.hint: Find the distance to the lookout on the signpost. Remember that they walk there and back.
items.explain: They walk 2.4 miles. The signpost says the lookout is 1.2 miles away, and 1.2 miles there plus 1.2 miles back is 2.4 miles. 2 miles is the distance to the creek.

items.prompt: Ben is 50 inches tall. He wants to try the Spacewalk Ride. What must he do first?
options: Nothing, because he is tall enough
Get a free time ticket at the Space Wing desk
Type 24 into the guide player
Measure his height at the theater
items.hint: Find the Spacewalk Ride in the note and list its symbols. Check what each symbol asks him to do.
items.explain: He gets a free time ticket first. The Spacewalk Ride shows 📏 and ⏰. He is tall enough for the 48-inch rule, but ⏰ means he needs a time ticket from the Space Wing desk.

items.prompt: Priya wants a quiet visit with no loud sounds. Which exhibit has a symbol that warns her?
options: Mars Rover Driving Game
Moon Rock
Rocket Launch Theater
Spacewalk Ride
items.hint: Find the symbol for loud sounds in the key. Then find which exhibit in the note shows it.
items.explain: The Rocket Launch Theater warns her. It shows 🔊, and the key says 🔊 means loud sounds.

items.prompt: Which two exhibits can Sam hear about on the audio guide?
options: Moon Rock and Mars Rover Driving Game
Meteorite Touch Table and Rocket Launch Theater
Spacewalk Ride and Moon Rock
Moon Rock and Meteorite Touch Table
items.hint: Find the audio guide symbol. Then look for every exhibit in the note that shows it.
items.explain: Moon Rock and the Meteorite Touch Table both show 🎧, with the numbers 21 and 24.

items.prompt: Leo wants to touch something that really came from space. Which exhibit should he go to?
options: Meteorite (space rock) Touch Table
Moon Rock
Mars Rover Driving Game
Spacewalk Ride
items.hint: Find the exhibits that are real objects from space. Then check which of them shows the hands-on symbol.
items.explain: He goes to the Meteorite Touch Table. A meteorite is a space rock, and it shows ✋ for hands-on. The Moon Rock came from space too, but it shows 👀 for look only.

items.prompt: The green light is flashing, and the arm is not moving. Leo wants a closer look. What should he do?
options: Step over the line, because the arm is not moving
Stay behind the line, because the arm can start again at any moment
Step closer as soon as a worker arrives
Step closer when the light turns red
items.hint: Find the row for a flashing green light. Read both the meaning and the Visitors rule.
items.explain: Leo stays behind the line. The flashing green row says the arm is paused and can start again at any moment.

items.prompt: A worker walks inside the yellow line to fix an arm. Which light should be on?
options: Steady green
Flashing green
Blue
Red
items.hint: Find the row that lets a worker go inside the line. Check the red row too.
items.explain: The blue light should be on. The Blue row says the arm is locked and a trained worker may go inside the line. The Red row says a worker locks the arm before anyone goes near it.

items.prompt: An arm shows a steady green light and a yellow light at the same time. What does this tell the club?
options: The arm has stopped because of a problem
The arm is locked for repair
The arm is paused
The arm is working, but it needs parts or a check soon
items.hint: Read the note. Then read the row for each light and put the two meanings together.
items.explain: The arm is working, but it needs parts or a check soon. The note says to read the row for each light: steady green means working, and yellow means it needs parts or a check soon.

items.prompt: It is May 12. Sam wants to watch the seal pups. What should he do?
options: Take the cliff path to the viewing deck and use the free binoculars
Walk the lower path, staying 50 yards from the seals
Walk along the beach slowly until a pup lifts its head
Wait at the lower path until the tide goes out
items.hint: Check whether May 12 is inside the pup season dates. Then read where that row tells you to go.
items.explain: He takes the cliff path to the viewing deck. May 12 is between March 1 and June 30, so the lower path is closed. The Viewing deck row says the binoculars are free.

items.prompt: It is August 3 at 2:00 PM. Ana wants to walk the lower path. What should she do?
options: Walk the lower path now, because pup season is over
Use the cliff path now, or wait until after 3:40 PM for the lower path
Walk the lower path quickly, before high tide at 2:40 PM
Stay off both paths, because it is summer
items.hint: Check two rows: the pup season dates and the tide times. Ask if each one allows the lower path at 2:00 PM on August 3.
items.explain: She uses the cliff path now or waits until after 3:40 PM. Pup season is over, but the Tides row says to stay off the lower path from 1:40 PM to 3:40 PM, and 2:00 PM is inside that time.

items.prompt: On July 10, Maya walks the lower path. She sees a seal pup alone on the sand ahead. What should she do?
options: Carry the pup down to the water
Sit close by so the pup is not alone
Stay at least 50 yards away, because the mother will come back
Move the pup to a safer spot on the rocks
items.hint: Find the row about pups. Read why a pup may be alone and what people should do.
items.explain: She stays at least 50 yards away. The Pups row says a mother often leaves her pup while she feeds at sea, so people do not touch or move it and stay back so she can come back.

items.prompt: Leo is 70 yards from a seal. The seal lifts its head and watches him. What should he do?
options: Stay where he is, because 70 yards is more than 50 yards
Walk closer to take a photo
Wave so the seal can see he is friendly
Back away slowly
items.hint: Compare 70 with the distance rule. Then read the Too close row. Decide which row tells him what to do right now.
items.explain: Leo backs away slowly. He is farther than 50 yards, but the Too close row says that if a seal lifts its head to watch you, you are too close.

items.prompt: Ana cannot eat peanuts or tree nuts, and she has only a bank card with her. Which stall can she buy lunch from?
options: Stall 6, corn on the cob
Stall 4, rice bowls
Stall 2, fruit cups
Stall 5, honey cakes
items.hint: Cross out every option with the nut symbol. Then check the payment symbols for the ones that are left.
items.explain: She buys from Stall 6. Its row has no 🥜, and it shows 💳, so it takes cards. Stall 2 has no nuts, but it takes cash only.

items.prompt: Sam arrives at 11:30 AM. He hopes to get fish tacos. What is the best plan?
options: Wait for the taco stall to open at 1:00 PM
Have a second choice ready, because the tacos often sell out by 11:00 AM
Bring cash, because Stall 3 takes cash only
Buy tacos at Stall 1, which sells them too
items.hint: Find the taco stall. Read every symbol in its row, and check the key for the clock symbol.
items.explain: Sam has a second choice ready. Stall 3 shows ⏰, and the key says it often sells out by 11:00 AM. He arrives at 11:30 AM.

items.prompt: Grandma Rose is buying lunch for a guest who eats no animal foods. Which stalls fit?
options: Stalls 1, 2 and 6
Stalls 3, 4 and 6
Stalls 2, 4 and 6
Stalls 2, 5 and 6
items.hint: Find the symbol that means no animal foods. List every stall that shows it.
items.explain: Stalls 2, 4 and 6 fit. Each one shows 🌱, and the key says 🌱 means no animal foods.

items.prompt: Maya and her dad bring a younger neighbor who is 45 inches tall. Where should the neighbor sit?
options: Alone in a cart
Next to Maya
Nowhere, because the neighbor is too short to ride
Next to Maya's dad
items.hint: Compare 45 inches with both numbers on the yellow sign. Then check who in the group is an adult.
items.explain: The neighbor sits next to Maya's dad. 45 inches is tall enough to ride, but it is under 48 inches, so the rider must sit next to an adult. Maya is 11, so she is not an adult.

items.prompt: It is 3:50 PM. Sam wants a ticket for the last train. What will happen?
options: He is too late, because ticket sales ended at 3:45 PM
He can buy a ticket for the 4:00 PM train
He can wait for a 4:20 PM train
He can buy a ticket on the train
items.hint: Find the time of the last train. Then use the ticket sign to work out when sales end.
items.explain: He is too late. The last train is at 4:00 PM, and the green sign says ticket sales end 15 minutes before it, at 3:45 PM.

items.prompt: Ben rides the 2:20 PM train today. About what time will he get back to the platform?
items.hint: Two signs give a ride time. Check which one is for today.
items.explain: He gets back at about 2:35 PM. The usual ride is 25 minutes, but the orange sign says today the ride is 15 minutes, and 15 minutes after 2:20 PM is 2:35 PM.

items.prompt: Leo wants to hold the T. rex tooth. What do the labels tell him?
options: He may only look at it, because the star means it is real
He may hold it, because its green label means a cast made for handling
He may hold it only after his class leaves
He may only look at it from behind the rope
items.hint: Find the T. rex tooth label. Check what its color means and what its star means, one at a time.
items.explain: He may hold it. The tooth has a green label, which means a cast made for handling. The star only means the real tooth is kept in the Fossil Lab.

items.prompt: Where is the real fossil that the T. rex skeleton was copied from?
options: In the Dinosaur Hall, behind the rope
On the green label table
Upstairs in the museum's Fossil Lab
In the first room, with a blue label
items.hint: Look at the T. rex skeleton label. Then find what the star means in the second paragraph.
items.explain: It is upstairs in the Fossil Lab. The skeleton's label has a star, and the second paragraph says a star means the real fossil is kept in the museum's Fossil Lab.

items.prompt: Ben wants to see a real dinosaur skull, not a copy. Which display should he go to?
options: T. rex skeleton
Triceratops horn
T. rex tooth
Triceratops skull
items.hint: Find the label color that means a real fossil. Then find the skull with that color.
items.explain: He goes to the Triceratops skull. Its label is blue, and blue means a real fossil. The T. rex skeleton has a white label, which means a cast.

items.prompt: Tap the sentence that tells why museums often show casts.
items.hint: Find the sentence in the first paragraph that names casts and gives a reason with the word so.
items.explain: The fourth sentence says real fossils are heavy and can crack, so museums often show casts.

steps.say: Sam needs to leave. So I look for the sign that shows the way out.
STAFF ONLY is for people who work here. RESTROOMS is the bathroom.
EXIT means the way out of a building.
The EXIT sign is on the middle door. So Sam uses the middle door.
